home.introTitle: What is Reactify Cheque Printing System?
home.introBody: Reactify Cheque Printing System is a web-based application that helps businesses in Nepal prepare cheque details accurately and print them neatly onto their existing cheque leaves. Instead of handwriting cheques, you select your bank's template, enter the details once, preview the result, and print — consistently, every time.
home.introWhoBody: Businesses, organizations, and individuals in Nepal who write cheques regularly and want a faster, neater, and more consistent way to prepare them.
home.introSolveBody: Handwritten cheques can suffer from unclear figures, mistakes in the amount-in-words, and layout errors that lead to rejections and rewrites. The system prepares every field — including amount in words — and shows a preview before printing.
home.benefitsSubtitle: Why businesses choose Reactify Cheque Printer System
home.benefit1Desc: Enter cheque details once in a guided form — no more careful handwriting.
home.benefit2Desc: Every cheque follows the same clean layout, so your records look professional.
home.benefit3Desc: See exactly how the cheque will look before it reaches the printer.
home.benefit4Desc: Align printed fields to your cheque book with the built-in calibration tool.
home.benefit5Desc: Templates for major Nepalese banks keep every field in the right place.
home.benefit6Desc: Secure accounts, role-based access, and subscription management are built in.

home.stepCalibrateDesc: Fine-tune alignment if your printer needs it.
home.ctaTrialNote: Start with a free 24-hour trial — no credit card required.
home.contactSubtitle: Questions about the system, pricing, or your subscription? We're happy to help.
home.heroBadge: No bank passwords. No data sharing. 100% private.
home.demoTitle: Try it live — no sign-up needed
home.demoDescription: Type an amount and see how it converts to words and looks on a real cheque leaf.
home.demoDisclaimer: This is a fictional demonstration cheque and is not valid for payment.
home.banksSubtitle: Pre-calibrated templates for 10 major Nepalese banks — more added regularly.
home.printersDesc: No special hardware needed. Works with any standard laser or inkjet printer — Epson, Canon, HP, Brother and more. Set your alignment once and print.
home.faqQ1: Do I need a special printer?
home.faqA1: No. Reactify works with any standard laser or inkjet printer — Epson, Canon, HP, Brother and more. Cheque size (190.5 × 88.9 mm) is handled by our templates.
home.faqQ2: How do I align the cheque with my printer?
home.faqA2: Print the built-in calibration sample, compare it with your cheque leaf, and adjust top/left offsets in millimetres. Most users are done in one or two tries.
home.faqQ3: What happens when my trial ends?
home.faqA3: Yes! We offer a 24-hour free trial with 5 test prints. No credit card required. You can upgrade to a paid plan at any time.
home.faqA4: We never ask for bank passwords or online-banking credentials. You only enter the payee name, amount and date that get printed on your own cheque leaf.
home.paymentsNote: Pay securely with Fonepay QR — upload your payment proof for quick activation.

legal.privacyIntro: This Privacy Policy explains how Reactify Software Technologies Pvt. Ltd. ("we", "us") collects, uses, and protects your information when you use Reactify Cheque Printer System.
legal.privacyWeCollect1: Account details you provide when registering: full name, email address, phone number, and optional company name.
legal.privacyWeCollect2: Cheque details you enter for printing: payee name, amount, date, and optional notes.
legal.privacyWeCollect3: Technical and usage data, such as print history, needed to operate the service.

about.title: About Reactify Cheque Printer System
about.description: We are dedicated to simplifying cheque printing for Nepalese businesses.
about.storyP1: Reactify Software Technologies crafts efficient software solutions that scale. We noticed Nepalese businesses spend too much time and effort on cheque printing, so we set out to create a solution that would make cheque printing as simple as filling out a form.
about.storyP2: With pre-configured templates for all major Nepalese banks and precise alignment technology, we've helped hundreds of businesses streamline their payment processes.
about.missionDesc: To simplify cheque printing for every Nepalese business, making financial transactions faster and more accurate.
about.customersDesc: Every feature we build starts with our customers' needs. Your feedback drives our development.
about.qualityDesc: We ensure every template is precisely calibrated for accurate printing on every cheque.
about.visionDesc: To become Nepal's most trusted cheque printing platform, serving businesses of all sizes.
about.teamDescription: A dedicated team of developers, designers, and customer support professionals committed to making cheque printing effortless.

features.title: Features
features.description: Discover all the features that make Reactify Cheque Printer System the best choice for cheque printing.
features.preciseAlignmentDesc: Our templates are carefully calibrated to ensure your cheque details print exactly where they should, eliminating misalignment issues.
features.multipleBanksDesc: Support for all major Nepalese banks including Nabil, Global IME, Siddhartha, and more. Each template is designed to match the exact cheque dimensions.
features.secureDesc: Your cheque data is stored securely and visible only to your account. We never share your information with third parties.
features.historyDesc: Keep a complete record of all your printed cheques. Easily reprint or reference past transactions.
features.amountInWordsDesc: Automatic conversion of numerical amounts to words in both Nepali and English for Nepalese Rupees.
features.customizationDesc: Adjust template settings to match your specific printing needs and preferences.
features.exportDesc: Save your cheques as PDF files for digital records or sharing with your accounting team.
features.multiUserDesc: Allow multiple team members to access and print cheques with role-based permissions.
features.ctaDescription: Start your free trial today and experience the ease of Reactify Cheque Printer System.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to common questions about Reactify Cheque Printer System.
faq.a1: We support all major Nepalese banks including Nabil Bank, Global IME Bank, Siddhartha Bank, NIC Asia, Prabhu Bank, and many more. We're constantly adding new bank templates.
faq.q2: How accurate is the cheque printing?
faq.a2: Our templates are precisely calibrated to ensure accurate alignment. We test each template thoroughly to match the exact cheque dimensions of each bank.
faq.a3: Yes! We offer a 24-hour free trial with 5 test prints. No credit card required. You can upgrade to a paid plan at any time.
faq.q4: Can I print cheques in bulk?
faq.a4: Yes, our Business plan includes bulk printing features, allowing you to print multiple cheques at once. This is perfect for businesses with high-volume payment needs.
faq.a5: Absolutely. We use industry-standard encryption to protect your data. Your cheque information is stored securely and is never shared with third parties.
faq.a6: We offer email support for all plans, with priority support for Business plan users. You can reach us at support@reactifysoftwaretechnologies.com.np.
